description: This file defines a generic class 'MemoryPooledCache' implementing the IQueueCache and ICacheDataAdapter interfaces, providing a pooled in-memory cache for streaming data, including serialization, buffer management, and eviction strategies. It also contains inner classes for cursor management.

classes.name: MemoryPooledCache`1
classes.description: A pooled cache implementation for memory stream providers with serialization and eviction strategies.

classes.name: MemoryPooledCache<TSerializer>.Cursor
classes.description: An implementation of IQueueCacheCursor used to iterate over cache messages.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the pooled cache with buffers, serializers, eviction strategy, and monitoring components.

methods.description: Converts a MemoryMessageData into a CachedMessage including stream position info.

methods.name: SerializeMessageIntoPooledSegment
methods.description: Serializes a message payload into a buffer segment, handling buffer allocation and size checks.

methods.name: GetStreamPosition
methods.description: Constructs a StreamPosition object from a MemoryMessageData.

methods.name: GetMaxAddCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of items that can be added to the cache in one operation.

methods.name: AddToCache
methods.description: Adds a list of batch messages to the cache after conversion to internal format.

methods.name: TryPurgeFromCache
methods.description: Performs cache purging using the eviction strategy.

methods.name: GetCacheCursor
methods.description: Returns a cursor for traversing messages in the cache for a given stream and token.

methods.description: Indicates whether the cache is under pressure (full or overloaded).

methods.description: Retrieves a sequence token for a cached message.
